item.description: 🇺🇸 Apple has outperformed expectations in its first-quarter financial results. The company reported earnings per share (EPS) of $2.84, exceeding the forecast of $2.68. Revenue totaled $143.76 billion, surpassing the expected $138.4 billion. Product revenue was $113.74 billion, which was higher than the anticipated $107.69 billion. iPhone revenue reached $85.27 billion, exceeding the estimate of $78.31 billion. However, revenue in the Americas fell short at $58.53 billion, below the expectation of $59.06 billion, while revenue from Greater China was $25.53 billion, surpassing the forecast of $21.82 billion.
